newsitem.title: USA: CBOT soy jumps on weather, Nov breaks resistance.
newsitem.headline: CBOT soy jumps on weather, Nov breaks resistance.

text.p: CBOT soybean futures moved to the day's highs past midday on weather updates indicating Hurricane Fran would shift further north, leaving little hope for significant rainfall soon in the key eastern U.S. soybean growing region, traders said.

New crop November soybeans broke above technical resistance at the $7.85 per bushel level which touched off buy stops, they said. But it was a quiet rally, with Refco Inc and Dean Witter Reynolds key purchasers of the November.
At 1228 CDT, soybeans were five to 10-3/4 cents per bushel higher, with November up 8-1/4 at $7.88-1/2.
